_note: Numbered board — each beat: feeling / framing / impact (the RentOK creative-quality learning). Timecodes are in the assembled film; clip_s is the Veo purchase length (4/6/8) trimmed to use_s by code.

identity_anchors.protagonist: a lean Indian man of about 40, sun-darkened skin, long tangled black hair to the shoulders streaked with grey, a thick unkempt black beard with grey at the chin, a faded torn dark-green cotton shirt with the sleeves ripped off, ragged khaki trousers cut off below the knee, barefoot, a thin cord bracelet on his left wrist, weathered but calm eyes
identity_anchors.bag: a deep navy-blue backpack with a smooth matte coated fabric, slim rectangular shape about 48 cm tall, one vertical front zip with a black zip pull, a front bucket pocket with two black zip pulls, black padded shoulder straps, a small black grab handle on top, a bright sunshine-yellow lining inside, a small plain tonal rectangular patch low on the front, no lettering and no logo anywhere on it
identity_anchors.island: a grey volcanic island: black-grey pebble shore, dark wet rock, low grey cloud, cold wind, grey-green sea, no buildings, no people
identity_anchors.grade: desaturated cold grey-teal; the navy bag and its yellow lining are the only saturated colours until the dawn of beat 6

beats.title: Years
beats.feeling: endurance — he has been here a very long time
beats.framing: opens in extreme close-up on his hand scratching one more tally mark into dark rock already covered in hundreds; the camera pulls back and rises to reveal him small on the grey shore
beats.impact: the pull-back is the reveal of scale (the marks = years); sound: wind, surf, the scrape of stone; no music
beats.canon: open in the middle of the action on a close-up (sk_abcd_0007); a visual burr in the first frame (sk_ogx_0040)

beats.title: The bag
beats.feeling: recognition — the first colour in a grey world
beats.framing: low and close at the tideline: the navy backpack half-buried in grey pebbles, a wave washing over it; his bare feet enter, he crouches, a hand brushes sand off the fabric
beats.impact: the hit is colour: navy against grey; the wordmark super (code) appears 5.0–7.5 s; sound: one wave hiss then quiet
beats.canon: brand early (sk_abcd_0010/0011); name within ten seconds (sk_ogx_0039); one dominant cue by contrast (CA-D1)

beats.title: Her
beats.feeling: the reason — why he will go back
beats.framing: over his shoulder: he unzips the front, the yellow lining glows, he lifts out a small photograph of a smiling woman; cut in his face as he looks at it
beats.impact: the yellow is the first warmth; the music bed enters under her photo; sound: the zip, wind dropping
beats.canon: the hero wants something and something opposes him — answerable at any frame (sk_sb_c003_0014); emotion preserved at the cut (sk_murch_c003_0020)

beats.title: The reveal (the gag)
beats.feeling: disbelief, then a laugh — the bag holds an absurd amount
beats.framing: locked-off medium shot, straight on, the open bag centre frame on the pebbles, him kneeling behind it: his hand goes in, then the forearm, the elbow, the whole arm to the shoulder; he pauses, puzzled; the other arm goes in too, both arms to the shoulders in a 30-litre backpack; then he draws out a coil of rope, a coconut, and a wooden paddle far longer than the bag
beats.impact: deadpan: the camera does not move, the music does not sting; the joke is the hold and the paddle; sound: rustle, the rope's rasp, the paddle's knock; a single dry exhale from him
beats.canon: humour as an accent, not a language (sk_whip_0058) — played dry, no mugging; exaggeration based on a truth (sk_whip_0031): 30L, 'a change of clothes for an overnight trip, and all your daily essentials', hidden compartments; the reveal effective through surprise (sk_fre_c003_0025); the picture as salesman (sk_hop_sa_0026) — HERO FRAME = both arms in to the shoulders

beats.title: Packing
beats.framing: close on hands and the open bag: coconuts, a bundle of dried fish, a water gourd, rope, a red signal flare go in one after another; he pulls the zip shut — it closes
beats.impact: pace: the fastest beat; the music lifts; each item opens a gap ('what else?') and the zip closes it; sound: thuds, the zip
beats.canon: surprise decays, curiosity carries (sk_hea_mts_0011); a new shot carries new information (sk_gote_c003_0004)

beats.title: Home
beats.framing: wide at dawn: he wades into the sea pushing a small driftwood raft, the navy backpack on his back, climbs on and paddles toward a gold horizon; the island black behind him
beats.impact: the widest frame of the film; the first warm light; the music opens; sound: paddle strokes, the sea
beats.canon: screen direction: he travels left-to-right in beats 1 and 6 (sk_gos_c003_0007); every move motivated (CA-D11)

beats.title: Brand close (code)
beats.feeling: home — the brand as the destination
beats.framing: end card on deep navy: the wordmark, the product line, the tagline, the CTA, inside the safe box; crossfade from the dawn
beats.canon: commercials that end by showing the package (sk_ogx_0039); the product is the hero (sk_ogl_c003_0014); the wordmark placed as-is (sk_vig_c003_0013)

hero_frame.description: both arms in the backpack to the shoulders, his face puzzled; the paddle not yet out

audio.music_bed: lyria, enters at 7.5 s under her photo, lifts at 20.5, opens at 24.5, resolves by 30.0
